notes: Tokyo · only: Area logic for the only-here layer. (1) Leg 1 (Toshima): Tue 15 Dec land at Haneda, forward the bags, take the monorail to Oi Keibajo-mae for the final-season Tokyo Mega Illumi (closed on Oi race days, so check TCK's December calendar). Wed 16 Dec is the winter sumo tour at Hasuda (an hour north from Ikebukuro via Omiya). It is sold out, so watch e+ resale. It also means the stables are on tour, so confirm Arashio-beya's Dec 17 practice is actually on. Fri 18 Dec: NOAH at Korakuen, then Spa LaQua next door instead of crossing to Kabukicho. (2) Leg 2 (Shinjuku): Sat 26 Dec is a cruise day; the Odaiba fireworks are confirmed on Sat 26 Dec (also 5/12/19 Dec). Book Funasei's shared boat as the named cruise fallback (charters need 20+); the rain fallback is TJPW at Korakuen at 18:30. COUNTDOWN JAPAN runs 26/27/29 Dec (no show on the 28th); go Sat daytime, then Keiyo Line to the pier. (3) Sun 27 Dec is the clash day: Arima Kinen (Nakayama, online tickets only), DDT RING FINALE (Korakuen 11:30, lottery) and Kawasaki vs Chiba Jets (15:05) all compete with the Plan C Sunrockers evening. Pick one daytime event plus the Sunrockers game (Nakayama or Korakuen to Aomi is about 35-60 min). (4) Mon 28 Dec is the last full day: Sendagaya youth sport (Winter Cup women's final and the high-school football opener at the National Stadium, both 2026 dates still unconfirmed), Zauo Shinjuku dinner, then Ameyoko's year-end crush or Shinjuku karaoke. Year-end traps: Mega Illumi closes 24 Dec-1 Jan; many restaurants close from 29/30 Dec; Comiket C109 (Big Sight, 29-31 Dec) floods the Rinkai line and Haneda buses on the morning of the 29th, so leave for the 17:20 flight early. Betting at Nakayama or Oi is 20+ only, the same as drinking. No pass is needed: Suica plus the Keiyo/Rinkai lines covers Makuhari, Funabashi and Aomi.
